pages.title: ADFM Public Equities Baskets
pages.description: Compares ADFM equity baskets across leadership, trend strength, dispersion, and benchmark-relative performance.
pages.data_sources: Internal basket definitions; Yahoo Finance market data

pages.title: Global Macro Regime
pages.description: Separates growth, inflation, rates, liquidity, and risk confirmation into a transparent cross-asset macro read, then highlights where those signals agree or conflict.
pages.data_sources: Federal Reserve / FRED primary macro series; Yahoo Finance market proxies

pages.title: Liquidity Conditions Monitor
pages.description: Separates the level and marginal impulse of system liquidity across Federal Reserve balance-sheet plumbing, overnight funding, credit transmission, and a capped market-confirmation sleeve.
pages.data_sources: Federal Reserve H.4.1; New York Fed rates and RRP; ICE BofA OAS via FRED; broad dollar; real yields; Yahoo Finance confirmation proxies

pages.title: Yield Curve Rates Regime Monitor
pages.description: Tracks outright U.S. Treasury yield levels, curve shape, and bull/bear steepener or flattener regimes across multiple horizons.
pages.data_sources: Yahoo Finance Treasury yield symbols: ^IRX, ^FVX, ^TNX, ^TYX

pages.title: Credit Conditions Monitor
pages.description: Separates credit-spread stress from outright funding-cost pressure, then checks banks, loans, volatility, and global benchmark 10-year government-yield repricing across flexible horizons.
pages.data_sources: ICE BofA corporate OAS and U.S. Treasury yields via Federal Reserve FRED; Yahoo Finance market confirmation; Trading Economics or fresh Stooq sovereign yields with OECD/FRED structural fallback

pages.title: Currency Tension Engine
pages.description: Maps currencies across trajectory and valuation-policy stretch, with carry, pillar scores, overlays, and daily risk flags.
pages.data_sources: Persisted Currency Tension Engine snapshot and configured adapters

pages.title: Sector Breadth and Rotation
pages.description: Measures participation and sector rotation to identify where equity strength is broadening or narrowing.
pages.data_sources: Yahoo Finance sector and subsector ETFs

pages.title: Equity Leadership & Rotation
pages.description: Ranks all 11 S&P 500 sectors versus SPY, five China/U.S. relationships, three breadth and alternative-weighting ratios, and six inter-sector relationships.
pages.data_sources: Yahoo Finance adjusted ETF and index prices

pages.title: ADFM Underwriter
pages.description: Calculates filing-driven valuation, per-share growth, margins, returns, liquidity, capital structure, issuer-credit ratios, debt maturities, and recent SEC events.
pages.data_sources: SEC EDGAR Company Facts and submissions; Yahoo Finance completed-session close and price history

pages.title: ADFM Chart Terminal
pages.description: Explores multi-timeframe chart structure, trend, momentum, volatility bands, and key moving averages.
pages.data_sources: Yahoo Finance OHLCV

pages.title: Cross-Asset Ratio Chartbook
pages.description: Provides grouped historical inspection of 38 duration, crisis-hedge, commodity, credit, funding, and financial-intermediary ratios, plus custom relationships.
pages.data_sources: Yahoo Finance adjusted close history

pages.title: Rate of Change Regime Explorer
pages.description: Tracks multi-horizon rate-of-change regimes for fast reads on momentum, acceleration, and trend pressure.
pages.data_sources: Yahoo Finance daily OHLCV

pages.title: Relative Volatility Lab
pages.description: Decomposes selectable realized-volatility ratios and compares them with implied volatility, acceleration, downside, semiconductor, and breadth diagnostics.
pages.data_sources: Yahoo Finance adjusted close history; implied-volatility indexes and ETF proxies where available

pages.title: ETF Flow Pressure Proxy
pages.description: Tracks ETF flow-pressure proxies to monitor allocation shifts across macro, equity, and thematic exposures.
pages.data_sources: Yahoo Finance OHLCV

pages.title: Volume Based Sentiment Indicator
pages.description: Reads conviction, participation, and sentiment using volume-regime signals across major liquid assets.
pages.data_sources: Yahoo Finance adjusted OHLCV; provider fallback where available

pages.title: Options Positioning Compass
pages.description: Maps current implied-volatility richness, downside skew, term structure, and aggregate option activity across a selected universe.
pages.data_sources: Yahoo Finance current option chains and adjusted close history

pages.title: SEC 13F Exposure Browser
pages.description: Ranks institutional managers by a selected security's share of their disclosed Form 13F portfolio.
pages.data_sources: SEC Form 13F bulk data sets; SEC company ticker directory

pages.title: CFTC Positioning Monitor
pages.description: Scans CFTC futures positioning for crowded longs, crowded shorts, and sharp weekly shifts across financial and physical futures, with historical percentile and z-score context.
pages.data_sources: CFTC Public Reporting Environment; Yahoo Finance price overlays for mapped contracts

pages.title: Market Stress Composite
pages.description: Builds a cross-asset stress score across equities, credit, commodities, FX, rates, breadth, and dispersion.
pages.data_sources: Yahoo Finance; local last-good cache on provider failure

pages.title: Catalyst Calendar
pages.description: Maps upcoming macro catalysts, options windows, Treasury supply, earnings season, and custom event risks.
pages.data_sources: Official agency calendars; recurring market-calendar rules; Yahoo Finance market proxies

pages.title: Hedge Timer
pages.description: Provides tactical timing cues for adding, holding, reducing, or rolling portfolio hedges.
pages.data_sources: Yahoo Finance; FRED regime inputs

pages.title: Position Sizing Lab
pages.description: Runs an interactive bankroll simulation using real historical holding-period outcomes, then pressure-tests conviction-based exposure against volatility, invalidation, event, tail, and liquidity risk.
pages.data_sources: Yahoo Finance adjusted OHLCV, earnings dates, and liquid cross-asset proxies

pages.title: Market Memory Explorer
pages.description: Surfaces historical analogs to contextualize the current tape against prior return paths and regimes.
pages.data_sources: Yahoo Finance market history

pages.title: Monthly Seasonality Explorer
pages.description: Shows recurring monthly return and volatility patterns by asset, index, sector, or commodity.
pages.data_sources: Yahoo Finance; FRED for selected series and regime tags

pages.title: Commodity Event Study
pages.description: Identifies historically extended commodity moves, waits for exhaustion or reversal confirmation, and measures how often those signals marked durable tops.
pages.data_sources: Yahoo Finance daily continuous-futures history; CFTC Disaggregated Managed Money positioning where mapped
